requiredScope: The complete required language and role scope remains in force.

Mutation/InsertQuery.role: An ordered write of the native cells produced by an independent checked SELECT.
Mutation/InsertQuery.structure: One destination, one checked SELECT with explicitly typed output roles and one detached RETURNING layout.
Mutation/InsertQuery.conditions: The output width matches the exact write layout. Each output has an admitted native assignment to its target kind. A text target accepts native text, signed int4 literal and physical field leaves, and NULL. Other int4 computed outputs remain in the signed-target domain. The independent definition is unbounded and unordered. The root verifies the return coordinates over the target.
Mutation/InsertQuery.meaning: Evaluate the independent SELECT with its source, scope, predicate and duplicate policy. Apply each assignment to the targeted physical field in output order. At a text destination, the fixed built-in int4 output and text input conversion turns a nonnull int4 into its signed ASCII decimal representation and propagates NULL. Omitted destination slots use native defaults.
Mutation/InsertQuery.sql: Emit the exact target layout and the producing SELECT with its original typed result roles. Leave the int4 conversion in the native assignment context, after DISTINCT. Type a bare NULL with the corresponding destination kind.

externalInterpretation: Use the same resolved ordinary input relations and the same writable destination. The input fixture has repeated, distinct and nullable native rows; the target fixture has known values and defaults. The stock pinned PostgreSQL catalog has no overriding pg_cast entry from int4 to text. Text-to-int4 assignment is rejected. The verifier measures the absence of a replacement cast.
observations: Preserve text values, exact target position, native result metadata and affected rows.
Preserve input duplicate policy, source predicates and zero-row writes.
Preserve SQL NULL distinctly from empty text and omit fields with native defaults.
Observe the exact target before and after the statement and restore both input and output fixture relations.
Check signed decimal text at negative, zero, positive and signed range boundaries. Retain duplicate elimination before target assignment and compare typed RETURNING values.

finite.completeness: Recover origin, assignment kind, positional native layout, exact literal value or source mode and duplicate policy from the constructed value. Keep 36 same-kind identities, 30 signed literal identities and 18 signed table identities.

exploration.requiredForms: Vary text field roles, typed constants, explicit NULL, no rows, native int4 positions, DISTINCT and returned slots. Include int4-to-text assignment from both a literal and a physical read.

analysis: Insert a bare text projection into a resolved text slot.
Insert mixed native fields with a target order differing from the physical layout.
Preserve mixed projection including DISTINCT and typed NULL in text.
Read a text field from an explicitly aliased independent source under a text presence predicate.
Assign a signed minimum int4 literal to native text.
Assign DISTINCT signed field reads to text, retaining the source type and eliminating duplicates before assignment.
negative: Pass a prepared parameter into a text query-write column lacking an admitted assignment marker role.
Directly give a native text expression to a signed integer target.
Provide a narrower SELECT than its destination.
faults: Read the other source text field for the same destination.
Discard the duplicate-elimination policy of the producing SELECT.
Discard the producing SELECT's admission predicate.
Replace a signed literal assigned to text by zero without changing the write position.
